facts.fact: A consultant on the team drafting Seychelles' National Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031 says the national validation workshop concluded in the two weeks before 10 July 2026, with no adoption stated; the strategy covers digital infrastructure, government services, AI, skills, innovation and the digital economy.
The strategy under development is titled National Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031, per the consultant's post of 10 July 2026.
